_meta.description: Historical macro shock database for analog pattern-matching
_meta.note: Return figures are approximate for pre-1990 shocks. Verify via FRED where critical.

shocks.name: Nixon Shock — End of Bretton Woods
shocks.key_rule: Monetary regime shifts produce initial equity bounce then 3-5yr structural volatility. Gold doubling = terminal signal.
shocks.second_order_1: USD devaluation → petrodollar pressure → 1973 oil embargo context

shocks.name: 1973 Arab Oil Embargo
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: Fed rate peak and deceleration + oil price stabilisation
shocks.key_rule: Supply disruptions >5% of global commodity → nonlinear price spikes. Energy → ag peak lag 19-21 months.
shocks.second_order_3: EM dollar debt stress → Latin American debt crisis precursor
shocks.second_order_4: IEA creation; CAFE standards; North Sea investment → 1986 glut
shocks.vault_note: Macro Shock Studies/Shock - 1973 Arab Oil Embargo.md

shocks.name: Second Oil Shock — Iranian Revolution
shocks.key_rule: Precautionary demand can amplify physical shortage 2-3x. Equity recovery begins at terminal rate, not CPI peak.
shocks.second_order_1: Precautionary inventory hoarding amplified 4% supply loss to market crisis
shocks.second_order_2: Volcker shock required to break embedded inflation expectations
shocks.second_order_3: Latin American debt crisis (1982): dollar-denominated debt + high rates
shocks.vault_note: Macro Shock Studies/Shock - 1979 Second Oil Shock.md

shocks.name: Volcker Disinflation Shock
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: Fed switches from money supply targeting to interest rate targeting (Aug 1982)
shocks.key_rule: Terminal rate signal = equity bottom, not CPI signal. Policy-induced demand destruction can be resolved only when CB signals direction change.
shocks.second_order_2: Latin American debt crisis: strong dollar + high rates = EM debt unserviceable
shocks.second_order_3: Great Moderation launched; 1982-2000 bull market begins

shocks.name: The Great Oil Glut
shocks.key_rule: Deflationary supply shocks are equity-bullish. Non-OPEC vs OPEC production ratio is the trigger signal.
shocks.second_order_1: Soviet hard currency crisis → geopolitical acceleration toward USSR dissolution
analog_conditions: OPEC considering market share vs price tradeoff
shocks.vault_note: Macro Shock Studies/Shock - 1986 Great Oil Glut.md

shocks.name: Black Monday
shocks.key_rule: >20% equity drop is buy signal IF credit spreads stable AND no commodity supply shock AND economy healthy.
shocks.second_order_2: Portfolio insurance abandoned as a strategy
analog_conditions: >10% rapid equity decline with stable credit spreads

shocks.name: Iraqi Invasion of Kuwait
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: Military outcome predictable (Fed rate cuts continued; equity bottom 3mo before Desert Storm)
shocks.key_rule: Geopolitical supply shocks with clear military resolution path are 3-6 month events. Equities bottom when outcome predictable, not when resolved.
shocks.second_order_2: Gulf War establishes US oil security doctrine
analog_conditions: geopolitical supply removal with clear resolution path

shocks.name: Asian Financial Crisis
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: Fed rate cuts post-LTCM (1998); US equities largely insulated
shocks.key_rule: EM currency crises are commodity deflationary and US equity bullish (capital flight to safety). Risk only if contagion reaches credit system.
shocks.second_order_2: Russian default + LTCM crisis (1998) — direct contagion chain
shocks.second_order_4: EM countries build massive FX reserves as structural response
analog_conditions: EM currency peg breaking with large USD debt
current account deficits funded by short-term capital
capital flight from EM to DM
shocks.vault_note: Macro Shock Studies/Shock - 1997 Asian Financial Crisis.md

shocks.name: Russian Default / LTCM Crisis
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: Fed intermeeting rate cut (Oct 15, 1998) — 1 week after equity trough
shocks.key_rule: Intermeeting Fed cut = highest-probability equity bottom signal in pure financial/leverage shocks.
shocks.second_order_2: Fed easing inflated final dot-com bubble phase
shocks.vault_note: Macro Shock Studies/Shock - 1998 Russian Default LTCM.md

shocks.name: Dot-Com Bubble Bust
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: Valuation compression to historical mean + earnings trough (rate cuts insufficient alone)
shocks.key_rule: Rate cuts do NOT resolve pure valuation corrections. L-shaped 3-5yr recovery. Accounting scandals cluster in year 2.
shocks.second_order_1: CapEx collapse: telecom overbuilding → Cisco/Lucent/Nortel revenue collapse
shocks.second_order_3: Gold bull market begins (2001-2011); capital rotates to commodities/RE
shocks.second_order_4: Housing boom enabled by 1% rates → seeds of 2008 GFC
analog_conditions: CapEx cycle sustained 3+ years in one sector
speculative investment detached from cash flows

shocks.name: 2008 Global Financial Crisis
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: Unconditional QE expansion (Fed March 18, 2009) + TED spread normalisation
shocks.key_rule: TED spread normalisation precedes equity bottom by 1-4 months. Unconditional CB commitment (not conditional) = bottom.
shocks.second_order_2: European banking stress → 2011 sovereign debt crisis
shocks.second_order_4: Wealth inequality amplification via asset price reflation
shocks.vault_note: Macro Shock Studies/Shock - 2008 Global Financial Crisis.md

shocks.name: European Sovereign Debt Crisis
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: EU 'comprehensive solution' announcement (Oct 2011); Draghi 'whatever it takes' (Jul 2012)
shocks.key_rule: Sovereign credit shocks in DM paradoxically drive yields LOWER (flight to quality). CB verbal backstop can be as powerful as actual intervention.
shocks.second_order_1: Decade of eurozone secular stagnation; ECB forced into ZIRP/NIRP
shocks.second_order_3: European Banking Union and ESM created
analog_conditions: currency union member debt sustainability in question
no CB backstop for sovereign debt
CB verbal commitment not yet made
shocks.vault_note: Macro Shock Studies/Shock - 2011 European Sovereign Debt.md

shocks.name: Shale Revolution Supply Shock
shocks.key_rule: Deflationary supply shocks: broad market bullish, energy sector concentrated loser. HY energy credit is the leading stress indicator.
shocks.second_order_1: HY energy spreads +12pp; wave of E&P defaults 2015-2016
shocks.second_order_2: Russian fiscal crisis; Saudi deficit -15% GDP; Venezuela collapse
shocks.second_order_3: Shale proved to be structural swing producer — permanently more elastic oil supply
analog_conditions: deflationary oil shock with healthy broad economy
shocks.vault_note: Macro Shock Studies/Shock - 2014 Shale Supply Shock.md

shocks.name: COVID-19 Pandemic
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: Fed unlimited QE announcement (March 23, 2020 — same day as trough)
shocks.key_rule: Unlimited CB backstop = equity trough signal (coincident). Exogenous shocks with healthy balance sheets + fast policy = V-shape potential.
shocks.second_order_1: WTI futures negative (-$37.63/bbl) — physical storage crisis
shocks.second_order_2: Tech sector benefited: remote work demand surge (Nasdaq new highs Jun 2020)
shocks.second_order_4: Supply chain fracture → semiconductor shortage; shipping +500%
analog_conditions: exogenous event causing revenue collapse across broad economy

shocks.name: Russia-Ukraine War
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: CPI inflection below consensus (Nov 10, 2022 print); approaching Fed terminal rate
shocks.key_rule: Pre-existing inflation + supply shock = forced aggressive tightening. CPI inflection (not level) = equity bottom signal.
shocks.second_order_1: European energy crisis: gas +400%, German deindustrialisation risk
shocks.second_order_2: MENA food import crisis: Egypt, Lebanon, Pakistan, Sri Lanka (default)
shocks.second_order_3: LNG infrastructure buildout; European energy transition acceleration

shocks.name: Hormuz Strait Blockade
shocks.equity_bottom_signal: TBD — watch for clarifying event (military/diplomatic resolution)
shocks.note: ACTIVE CASE — data incomplete. Update as situation develops.
shocks.key_rule: Choke point disruption requires 2x volatility premium vs nationalisation shocks. Watch for clarifying event.
analog_conditions: US naval presence caps duration risk

prediction_rules.rule: Supply disruptions removing >5% of a key commodity produce nonlinear price spikes
prediction_rules.mechanism: Near-zero short-run demand elasticity means small quantity changes = large price moves

prediction_rules.rule: Energy shocks filter through to agricultural/fertiliser price peaks 19-21 months later
prediction_rules.mechanism: Fertiliser production uses natural gas; supply chain lag to agricultural market

prediction_rules.rule: Equity recoveries begin when the central bank signals terminal rate, not when economic data bottoms
prediction_rules.mechanism: Markets price direction of policy change, not absolute level of macro data

prediction_rules.rule: An intermeeting Fed rate cut signals equity bottom within days
prediction_rules.mechanism: Unscheduled action signals systemic risk assessment + unlimited commitment

prediction_rules.rule: Global chokepoint disruptions (Hormuz, Suez) require 2x volatility premium vs single-producer disruptions
prediction_rules.mechanism: All supply chains disrupted simultaneously vs one producer's exports

prediction_rules.rule: Supply shock + pre-existing inflation above 5% = stagflation trap (Fed cannot ease)
prediction_rules.mechanism: CB faces credibility trade-off; must tighten into weakness; prolongs equity bear

prediction_rules.rule: Gold doubling within 12 months of a monetary regime change = terminal signal for stable equity returns
prediction_rules.mechanism: Gold prices the lost monetary anchor; sustained rise = embedded inflation expectations

prediction_rules.rule: Developed market sovereign downgrades drive yields LOWER (flight to quality), not higher
prediction_rules.mechanism: US/German Treasuries remain global safe haven regardless of ratings; capital flows in on stress

prediction_rules.rule: >20% equity drop is a buy signal if credit spreads stable + no commodity supply shock + economy healthy
prediction_rules.mechanism: Microstructure failures without fundamental deterioration resolve rapidly when liquidity restored

prediction_rules.rule: Rate cuts do NOT resolve pure valuation corrections — requires time for earnings to grow into valuations
prediction_rules.mechanism: Fundamental repricing needed; cheap money speeds up the next bubble, not the recovery

prediction_rules.rule: Unconditional (unlimited) central bank asset purchase commitment = equity trough signal (coincident)
prediction_rules.mechanism: Removes tail risk; restores market function; forces risk-on positioning

prediction_rules.rule: Deflationary (price-falling) supply shocks are equity-bullish — lower input costs boost broad margins
prediction_rules.mechanism: Energy cost savings flow to corporate margins and consumer purchasing power
